com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.event.eve: Event fired during server startup after assets are loaded. Use to initialize mod state, register commands, set up data structures.
Event fired when the server is shutting down. Use to save data, flush caches, clean up resources. Has priority constants for ordered shutdown phases.
Event fired when the universe is being prepared before worlds are created. Use to override or modify world configuration.

Event fired after authentication during player connection setup. Cancel to deny connection, whitelist or ban players, redirect player to another server on connect. Use referToServer() to transfer players between servers.
Event fired when a player disconnects during the setup phase before fully joining.
Event fired when a player connects and their entity is created. Use to choose which world a player spawns in, override world spawn for connecting player with setWorld(), send welcome messages.
Event fired when a player disconnects from the server. Use to save player data, clean up per-player state, log disconnections.

Async event fired when a player sends a chat message. How to modify chat messages from players: change content, filter profanity, format display. Cancel to suppress or mute. Change targets to control who sees messages. Supports custom chat channels.
Event fired when a player is ready in a world after chunks loaded and entity spawned. Use for world-specific join logic, custom join messages, welcome effects.
Event fired when a player is being moved out of a world. Override destination world or spawn position during world transfers.
Event fired after a player has left a world. Use for world-specific cleanup, custom leave messages.
Event fired when a client player signals it has finished loading. Use to trigger post-load actions, send initial UI, start tutorials.
Event fired when a player clicks a mouse button. Cancel to prevent the click from being processed. Use for custom click handling, UI interactions, tool usage overrides.
Event fired when a player moves their mouse. Cancel to prevent motion processing. Use for custom aiming, crosshair-dependent logic.
Deprecated event for player interactions. Use UseBlockEvent or UseEntityEvent instead.
Deprecated event fired when a player crafts a recipe. Use CraftRecipeEvent instead.
Event fired when a block is broken by an entity. Cancel to protect areas or prevent block breaking. Use to modify drops, log block breaks, check block types.
Event fired when a block is broken by environmental sources like fire or explosions with no instigating entity. Cannot be cancelled.
Event fired when a block is placed. Cancel to prevent placement. Set consumeItem(false) for free build zone with no item consumption. Use to protect areas, creative building, unlimited placement.
Event fired when block damage is applied. Cancel to prevent damage. Use for custom durability, damage multipliers, indestructible blocks.
Event fired when interacting with a block. Has Pre (cancellable, before interaction) and Post (after interaction) subclasses. Use for custom block interactions like doors, chests, buttons.
Event fired when interacting with an entity. Has Pre (cancellable) and Post subclasses. Use for custom entity interactions like NPCs, mounts, shopkeepers.

Event fired when crafting a recipe. Has Pre (cancel to stop crafting) and Post (cancel to prevent giving output) subclasses. Use for custom crafting restrictions, limiting what players can craft, bonus outputs, crafting achievements, recipe gating.
Event fired when dropping an item. Cancel to prevent drops, implement soulbound items. PlayerRequest subclass for player-initiated drops, Drop subclass for actual drop with configurable throw speed.
Event fired when picking up an item. Cancel to prevent pickups. Use for item ownership, pickup restrictions, modifying picked-up items.
Event fired when switching active inventory slots. Cancel to prevent slot switching. Use to lock hotbar slots, prevent switching during actions.
Event fired after the active inventory slot has changed. Use to react to slot changes, update UI, trigger effects.
Event fired each tick for queued inventory mutations. Use to track inventory changes, update caches, trigger effects on item gain or loss.
Event fired when changing game mode. Cancel to prevent the change. Use to restrict game mode changes, force specific modes.
Event fired when entering a game mode type. Cancel to prevent entering.
Event fired when exiting a game mode type. Cancel to keep the player in the game mode type.
Event fired when a dead player is about to respawn. Cancel to deny respawn and keep the player dead. Use for custom respawn logic, respawn cooldowns, conditional respawn denial, respawn timers.
Event fired to check if an entity can breathe. Override canBreathe to create custom breathing rules like NPCs that breathe underwater.
Event fired when an entity discovers a zone. Display subclass is cancellable to prevent zone name from showing. Use for custom zone discovery notifications, achievements.
Event fired when an entity is removed from the world. Use to cleanup entity-specific data, track entity deaths or despawns.
Event fired when player permissions change. Subclasses for permissions added, removed, and group membership changes.
Event fired when group permissions change. Subclasses for permissions added and removed from a group.
com.hypixel.hytale.builtin.adventure.obj: Event fired when a player opens a treasure chest. Use for custom loot tables, chest tracking, achievements.
com.hypixel.hytale.builtin.portals.event: Event fired when an entity enters a portal. Use for custom portal destinations, portal restrictions, logging.
com.hypixel.hytale.builtin.instances.eve: Event fired when an entity discovers an instance. Display subclass is cancellable to suppress discovery title.
com.hypixel.hytale.builtin.teleport.comm: Event fired when a warp is being modified. Cancel to protect important warps. Subclasses RemoveWarpEvent and ReplaceWarpEvent.
Event fired when a warp is being removed. Cancel to prevent warp deletion.
Event fired when a warp is being replaced. Cancel to prevent warp modification.
com.hypixel.hytale.builtin.triggervolume: Event fired when an entity enters or exits a trigger volume zone. Use for zone-based gameplay, area triggers, quest zones, PvP arenas.
com.hypixel.hytale.builtin.adventure.wor: Event fired when a scripted world event sequence completes. Reports SUCCESS or FAIL reason.
com.hypixel.hytale.event.IEventBus: Central event bus hub for registering event listeners and dispatching events. Supports sync, async, keyed, global, and unhandled registrations.
com.hypixel.hytale.event.EventBus: Default implementation of IEventBus. The central hub for event dispatch. Obtained via HytaleServer.get().getEventBus().
com.hypixel.hytale.event.IEvent: Interface for synchronous blocking events dispatched through the event bus.
com.hypixel.hytale.event.IAsyncEvent: Interface for asynchronous events that return CompletableFuture for non-blocking processing.
com.hypixel.hytale.event.ICancellable: Mixin interface for events that can be cancelled via setCancelled(true). The dispatching code checks isCancelled() and skips the action.
com.hypixel.hytale.event.EventPriority: Priority ordering for event listeners. FIRST (-21845), EARLY (-10922), NORMAL (0), LATE (10922), LAST (21845). Lower value runs first.
com.hypixel.hytale.event.EventRegistrati: Handle returned when registering an event listener. Call unregister() to remove the listener.
com.hypixel.hytale.component.event.Cance: Base class for cancellable ECS events dispatched through the Entity Component System on a per-entity basis.
com.hypixel.hytale.component.event.EcsEv: Base class for ECS events dispatched through the Entity Component System rather than the global event bus.
com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.HytaleSer: Main server class and entry point. Provides access to the event bus, universe, plugin manager, and all server systems via HytaleServer.get().
com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.plugin.Ja: Base class for Hytale mods/plugins. Extend this to create a mod. Provides setup(), event bus access, logger, and server API.
com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.plugin.Pl: Manages loading, enabling, and disabling of plugins/mods on the server.
Represents the game universe containing all worlds. Manages world creation, player connections, and server-wide state.
Reference to a connected player entity. Primary way to interact with players in the server API.
Represents a single game world within the universe. Contains chunks, entities, and block data.
com.hypixel.hytale.component.Component: Base marker interface for ECS components. Components hold data attached to entities or block entities.
com.hypixel.hytale.component.ComponentTy: Type descriptor for an ECS component. Used to register and look up components by type.
com.hypixel.hytale.component.ComponentRe: Registry for ECS component types. Register custom components here.
com.hypixel.hytale.component.Holder: Entity handle in the ECS. Points into an archetype-based store. Primary way to reference entities.
com.hypixel.hytale.component.Store: Generic ECS data store. Comes in EntityStore (per-entity) and ChunkStore (per-chunk block entities) flavors.
com.hypixel.hytale.component.CommandBuff: Queues deferred structural ECS changes like adding/removing components, creating/destroying entities.
com.hypixel.hytale.component.ComponentAc: Typed component getter for reading component data from entities.
com.hypixel.hytale.component.Archetype: Archetype-based storage internals. Groups entities by their component composition for data locality.
com.hypixel.hytale.assetstore.AssetStore: Central registry of all loaded game assets. Assets are JSON files decoded via codecs from asset packs.
com.hypixel.hytale.assetstore.AssetPack: Represents a loadable asset pack containing game content like block types, items, and entity definitions.
com.hypixel.hytale.assetstore.AssetMap: Key-to-asset lookup for finding loaded assets by string identifier.
com.hypixel.hytale.assetstore.AssetRegis: Typed asset registration for custom asset types.
com.hypixel.hytale.codec.Codec: Core serialization interface. Defines how Java objects are encoded to and decoded from BSON documents.
com.hypixel.hytale.codec.builder.Builder: Builder pattern codec for complex types with multiple fields.
com.hypixel.hytale.codec.lookup.CodecMap: Polymorphic codec that dispatches by a type discriminator field for type-keyed serialization.
com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.asset.typ: Asset type definition for blocks. Defines block properties, behavior, rendering, and physics.
Asset type definition for items. Defines item properties, usage, stacking, and interactions.
com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.inventory: Represents a stack of items in an inventory slot. Contains item type, count, and item data.
com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.command.A: Base class for server commands. Extend to create custom commands with arguments and permission checks.
Base class for asynchronous server commands that run off the main thread.
com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.command.C: Context passed to command execution containing the sender, parsed arguments, and server state.
Interface for entities that can execute commands. Players and the console are command senders.
com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.entity.wi: Server-side window/GUI container. Use WindowManager to open windows for players.
Manages opening and closing GUI windows for players.
com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.entity.pa: Base class for UI pages shown to players.
Dialog UI page for NPC conversations and dialog trees.
Shop UI page for buying and selling items from merchants.
com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.entity.da: Damage data structure representing damage dealt to an entity. Contains amount, type, source.
Calculates final damage after armor, resistances, and modifiers.
com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.permissio: Interface for entities that hold permissions. Players are permission holders.
Query object for checking whether a permission holder has a specific permission.
com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.modules.L: Runtime-reloadable configuration module. Supports hot-reloading server settings without restart.
com.hypixel.hytale.server.npc.blackboard: Data storage for NPC AI decisions. NPCs read and write blackboard values to make behavior choices.
com.hypixel.hytale.server.npc.flock.Floc: NPC group AI system based on flocking behavior. Manages flock members, beacons, and group state.
Manages world map configuration and world loading.
Generates world chunks with terrain, biomes, and structures.
com.hypixel.hytale.server.spawning.contr: Controls entity spawning behavior and spawn rules.
com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.entity.pr: Asset defining lists of prefabs for structure generation and placement.
com.hypixel.hytale.protocol.Packet: Base class for network packets sent between client and server.
com.hypixel.hytale.protocol.PacketIO: Reads and writes protocol data for network packet encoding and decoding.
com.hypixel.hytale.protocol.PacketHandle: Handles incoming network packets from connected clients.
com.hypixel.hytale.math.block.BlockSpher: Utility for generating sphere shapes with blocks in a voxel world.
com.hypixel.hytale.math.block.BlockCubeU: Utility for generating cube shapes with blocks.
com.hypixel.hytale.math.hitdetection.Hit: Executes hit detection including raycasts and frustum/orthogonal projection for targeting.
com.hypixel.hytale.math.iterator.BlockIt: Iterates over blocks in a region for batch operations.
Dependency graph for scheduling ECS systems. Systems declare dependencies and run in topological order.
Declares a dependency between ECS systems for execution ordering.
com.hypixel.hytale.component.system.ICan: Interface for cancellable ECS events. Base interface for all events dispatched through the ECS that support cancellation.
com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.entity.ef: Active entity effect applied to an entity. Represents a running effect instance with duration, stacking, and tick behavior. Use for buffs, debuffs, potion-like effects, abilities.
com.hypixel.hytale.server.npc.corecompon: NPC action that applies an entity effect to a target. Used in NPC AI combat behavior to trigger effects like poison, fire, slowness on hit.
NPC action that plays a sound at the NPC's location. Used in NPC AI behavior for playing sounds and audio effects.
com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.entity.en: Base class for creating custom UI pages displayed to players. Extend to build custom server-side UI with buttons, text, and interactive elements.
com.hypixel.hytale.protocol.packets.inte: Network packet for custom UI pages. Serializes custom page data between server and client for player UI rendering.
com.hypixel.hytale.builtin.hytalegenerat: Biome definition for world generation. Configures terrain shape, vegetation, weather, ambient sounds, and block palette for biome configuration.
Terrain generation asset defining how terrain is shaped. Configures noise layers, height maps, cave systems for biome terrain configuration.
Buffered chunk saver for world persistence and saving. Batches chunk data writes to disk for efficient world storage.
ECS system that sets up chunk loading and saving pipelines for world persistence and saving. Initializes the chunk storage lifecycle.
com.hypixel.hytale.protocol.ConnectedBlo: Defines connected block rules for block connections. Controls how blocks visually connect to adjacent blocks like fences, walls, pipes.
Server module managing connected blocks rule system. Handles block connection state and visual linking between adjacent blocks.
com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.modules.e: Collection of ECS systems handling entity damage processing. Manages damage calculation, hit indicators, death, breathing, and damage-related game logic.
Core server module for entity spawning and lifecycle management. Registers entity systems, manages entity creation, updates, and removal.
com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.inventory: ECS component holding entity inventory data. Provides hotbar, equipment slots, and bag storage for entity components and inventory.
com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.modules.e: ECS component for item entities in the world. Manages item stack data, pickup behavior, and item entity lifetime.
com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.entity.Li: Base class for living entities with health, damage, and AI. Players, NPCs, and creatures extend this for entity spawning and lifecycle.
com.hypixel.hytale.protocol.packets.worl: World map chunk data for client rendering. Contains map tile data for the minimap and world map display. Used in chunk loading.
com.hypixel.hytale.protocol.SoundEvent: Network protocol packet for playing sounds and audio. Sent from server to client to trigger sound effects at positions or on entities.
com.hypixel.hytale.server.spawning.Spawn: Server plugin module managing entity spawning and lifecycle. Controls spawn rules, spawn rates, despawn conditions, and spawn controllers.
Manages world map configuration and world loading. Handles map data and world map rendering for player navigation.
com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.io.Packet: Base handler for incoming network packets. Processes packet IO and network protocol messages from connected clients.
